component.name: Gnupg Desktop
component.summary: Cryptography toolkit for encrypting and signing under GNU/Linux

description.p:
Easily encrypt and decrypt emails, files and folders and verify their integrity (that they have not been altered) and origin (authenticity) using digital signatures.
Supports the two relevant cryptographic standards, OpenPGP and S/MIME (X.509). Also includes hardened version of the document viewer Okular which supports signing and verifying PDF documents using both standards. This AppImage is the official GnuPG distribution for GNU/Linux and is maintained by the GnuPG developers.
